findings.location: 독립 확인·다른 자리에서 사용하기: DE Decke die Vorbilder ab. Bilde ... Lege die zwei Lautschilder 니 und 무 ... (actual text: Lege die Lautschilder 니 und 무 zu zwei kleinen Übungskisten.)
findings.problem: The learner-facing DE paragraph gives both finished answers 니/무 immediately after asking the learner to hide models and assemble ㄴ+ㅣ / ㅁ+ㅜ. The KO I1/I2 likewise place 답 beside the prompt. Prior learning is allowed, but a visible solution during the response prevents the stated model-free structural check.
findings.proposal: Separate the response phase from the transfer phase. Learner DE: „Decke die Vorbilder und den Lösungsteil ab. Bilde aus ㅣ und ㄴ einen Silbenblock und aus ㅜ und ㅁ einen zweiten.“ Learner KO: „시범과 답을 가리고 ㅣ/ㄴ, ㅜ/ㅁ을 각각 한 글자로 모아요.“ Learner EN: “Cover the models and answers. Build one block from ㅣ and ㄴ, then another from ㅜ and ㅁ.” Put 니 (ㄴ links/ㅣ rechts) and 무 (ㅁ oben/ㅜ unten) in a separately hidden facilitator section. Reveal the current transfer paragraph only after both responses; keep prior-exposure limitation.
